map.美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表，评估急性脑卒中神经功能缺损严重程度，总分0-42分: National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale, assesses acute stroke neurological deficit severity; total 0-42
map.NIHSS 卒中量表总分 = 15 个神经功能项目（每项 0 至 4）之和，满分: NIHSS total = sum of 15 neurological items (each 0-4), max 42; 0 no stroke, <=4 mild, <=15 moderate, <=20 moderate-severe, >20 severe; higher score = worse deficit.
map.2 - 昏睡，需反复刺激或疼痛刺激才有反应: 2 - Stuporous, needs repeated or painful stimulation
map.3 - 昏迷，仅有反射活动或完全无反应: 3 - Coma, reflexive activity only or unresponsive
map.1c. 意识水平指令（睁闭眼、非瘫痪手握拳松开）: 1c. LOC commands (eyes open/close, non-paretic hand grip/release)
map.2 - 部分（下面部完全或几乎完全瘫痪）: 2 - Partial (lower face complete or near-complete paralysis)
map.2 - 重度感觉障碍（半侧痛温觉消失）: 2 - Severe sensory loss (hemi loss of pain/temp)
map.2 - 一种以上感觉严重忽视或半侧忽视: 2 - Severe neglect of more than one or hemineglect
map.轻微缺损，多数可静脉溶栓: Minor deficit, most eligible for IV thrombolysis
map.严重缺损，大血管闭塞可能，需血管内治疗: Severe deficit, possible large-vessel occlusion, needs endovascular therapy
map.NIHSS评分是急性缺血性卒中严重程度评估的金标准。评分≥6分提示大血管闭塞可能: NIHSS is the gold standard for acute ischemic stroke severity. Score >=6 suggests possible large-vessel occlusion; within IV thrombolysis window (4.5h) NIHSS guides decision; endovascular thrombectomy generally requires NIHSS>=6 with imaging-confirmed large-vessel occlusion. Higher score = worse prognosis.
map.急性缺血性卒中缺损量化与再灌注决策。: Acute ischemic stroke deficit quantification and reperfusion decisions.
map.预后与出血转化风险参考。: Prognosis and hemorrhagic transformation risk reference.
map.合计 4 分：轻度缺损（1~4），预后相对好。: Total 4: mild deficit (1-4), relatively good prognosis.
map.合计 18 分：中重度（16~21），需紧急评估取栓/溶栓并加强监护。: Total 18: moderate-severe (16-21), urgent thrombectomy/thrombolysis evaluation and intensified monitoring.
map.0 无、1~4 轻、5~15 中、16~21 中重、≥22 重；上限 42。: 0 none, 1-4 mild, 5-15 moderate, 16-21 mod-severe, >=22 severe; max 42.
map.24h 内下降 ≥4 常提示再灌注有效。: Drop >=4 within 24h often indicates effective reperfusion.
